role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism preflight; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: Are x-y-time sampling intervals in the six frozen bat panels sufficiently structured to define a cross-panel movement-state composition proxy without using vertical outcomes?

inputs.retained_records: Use the same frozen panel/session loaders as the centered-shape audit.
inputs.note: Existing loader may parse the frozen vertical field to reproduce retained records, but this preflight neither summarizes nor conditions decisions on vertical values.

decision_rule: Choose one harmonized maximum dt for the behavioural-composition analysis only after this x-y-time preflight. Prefer the smallest candidate among 300, 600, 1800 seconds that retains at least 80% of positive-dt steps in every primary comparative panel. If none does, use 1800 seconds and flag panels below 80%. Do not use vertical identity or future proxy correlations to choose the cap.
claim_boundary: Preflight only; no behavioural state or mechanism is inferred.
